topic.source_contract: playing-field consultation, policy exceptions, needs assessment, replacement provision and delivery

scope_guards: A playing-field map or historic use is not treated as a current capacity conclusion.
A needs assessment is not treated as planning permission.
A Sport England consultation response is not treated as construction approval.
A policy exception claim is not treated as demonstrated without its evidence.
Identified replacement land is not treated as secured, built or available provision.
A community-use proposal is not treated as an executed and monitored agreement.
CIL or section 106 allocation is not treated as completed sports infrastructure.
No score or promotion is written without exact field status, consultation, decision, secured replacement and operational delivery.
